textos.motores.advviral.acionamento: Timer: Monday to Friday at 08:00, weekly recap on Saturday
textos.motores.advviral.oque: Tracks what leading YouTube lawyers say about rights: consumer, social security, employment, debt, property, family, and scams. Nothing is presented as advice for your specific case, and proposed laws are clearly labeled as proposals.
textos.motores.advviral.serve: Daily summary of rights in plain language.
textos.motores.aventurasinemavideo.acionamento: Terminal / batch, with publishing to the Aventuras INEMA channel
textos.motores.aventurasinemavideo.oque: Turns real stories from the INEMA Aventura archive (2001 to 2012), using adventurers’ own accounts and photos, into narrated films lasting 1 to 3 minutes: restored photos with motion and narration in Nei’s voice.
textos.motores.contaviral.acionamento: Timer: generates at 10 a.m., publishes at 1 p.m.
textos.motores.contaviral.oque: Summarizes what the 10 largest accounting and tax channels said: laws and regulations, Tax Reform, MEI and Simples, income tax, and tax obligations, with labels (RULE CHANGED, PROPOSAL, DEADLINE, ALERT).
textos.motores.eventosextremospub.acionamento: Timers throughout the day (Weather 24 h, Daily Forecast, Weather of the DAY, alerts)
textos.motores.eventosextremospub.avatar: Yes — Nei through the HeyGen studio
textos.motores.eventosextremospub.oque: Turns severe weather alerts into a “crisis room” video: downloads public data (INMET alerts by municipality, GOES-19 satellite data, Open-Meteo forecasts), animates it all on a 3D map of southern Brazil, and shows the source of every figure.
textos.motores.eventosextremospub.serve: Daily weather, forecasts, and weekly alerts.
textos.motores.explicavideos.acionamento: Terminal (agent session) or bot: /explicavideo <assunto> in inemaccbot
textos.motores.explicavideos.avatar: Yes — Nei's avatar and voice from the HeyGen studio (there is also a version without an avatar, using a local voice)
textos.motores.explicavideos.oque: The base engine for explainer videos: the script becomes scenes with illustrations, chapters, and captions, while Nei's avatar speaks the text. It has a viral profile, with a strong opening hook and striking images.
textos.motores.explicavideos.serve: Explain a topic, tool, or INEMA project, from a long video to a short clip.
textos.motores.finviral.acionamento: Timer: Monday to Friday at 02:00, weekly recap on Saturday
textos.motores.finviral.oque: Reviews videos from leading finance influencers using transcripts, separates figures, facts, and controversies, then creates a video with large animated numbers, the source of each figure on screen, and commentary from Nei. No investment recommendations.
textos.motores.finviral.serve: Daily summary of finance discussions; “The week explained” on weekends.
textos.motores.futviral.acionamento: Timer: generates at 9 a.m., publishes at noon
textos.motores.futviral.oque: Summarizes what the 10 largest football channels said: Brasileirão, European football, transfers, and business, with labels (RUMOR, IN NEGOTIATIONS, CONFIRMED, CONTROVERSY). Rumors are treated as rumors, and betting is excluded.
textos.motores.gitbombando.oque: Every day, it makes the “Trending on GitHub” reel: the 10 projects that gained the most stars, in countdown order, with a card, the owner’s photo, a plain-English explanation, and the star count. It also creates two carousels.
textos.motores.historia-timelapse.oque: A 3D timelapse of a city’s history: real terrain, OpenStreetMap buildings appearing in the year the neighborhood was first occupied, an IBGE population counter, and cards with figures, explanations, and sources.
textos.motores.historia-timelapse.serve: City history in video, released in phases (music only, narrated, with avatar).
textos.motores.inemavox.nota_exemplos: Support engine: it does not publish its own videos.
textos.motores.inemavox.oque: A local AI voice suite used behind the scenes by all the engines: downloads videos, transcribes, generates speech (TTS), dubs, and trims, with models running on your graphics card and no API costs.
textos.motores.inemavox.serve: Voice, transcription, downloads, and music/sound effects for the other engines.
textos.motores.r7ex.acionamento: Terminal (/r7ex) or bot: /r7ex <tema> in inemaccbot; queued publishing with a timer
textos.motores.r7ex.avatar: Yes — Nei on half-screen for the hook, then in the corner (HeyGen)
textos.motores.r7ex.oque: A reel production line with a 7-step hook script, from an opening hook with a number to a request for comments, finished in a TV news style: a designed title at the opening, panels timed to the speech, a counter, and captions that light up with the voice.
textos.motores.r7ex.serve: A viral 40 to 50 second reel based on a strong thesis or opinion.
textos.motores.r7exp.acionamento: Terminal (agent session); engine still in prototype
textos.motores.r7exp.avatar: Yes — Nei's avatar (half-screen at the start, then in the corner)
textos.motores.r7exp.formato: Full 16:9 video + one 9:16 reel per option
textos.motores.r7exp.oque: A visual explainer that teaches options: a chart that works like a map, the same person moving through each scenario, panels that appear in time with the spoken words, and, at the end, what you can do.
textos.motores.r7exp.serve: Topics with different paths or scenarios ("which future", "which choice"), where each option needs an explanation.
textos.motores.reel-ciencia-3d.oque: A kit with a skill for Claude Code that turns an “What if…?” question into a science reel of about 60 seconds, made entirely with code (HyperFrames and Three.js), with a source for every figure and a locally generated voice.
textos.motores.reel-ciencia-3d.serve: Short science videos, with accurate figures.
textos.motores.reel7etapas.nota_exemplos: Older engine: this example shows the previous format, which led to r7ex. To see the current format, check the r7ex examples.
textos.motores.reel7etapas.oque: The first 7-step hook reel model (hook, desire, fear, ease, discovery, benefit, comment), with one image per step and editing in Python. Since 18/10/2026, r7ex has been the standard; the repository keeps the old engine and its history.
textos.motores.reel7etapas.serve: A reference for the 7-step script; new reels are made with r7ex.
textos.motores.refazvideo.acionamento: Terminal (agent session), with a preview and approval before generating the avatar
textos.motores.refazvideo.avatar: Yes — Nei's avatar and voice (HeyGen); rendered with explicavideos
textos.motores.refazvideo.oque: A step-by-step process for an AI agent to remake a reference video as its own explainer in Portuguese: it downloads and transcribes the video, writes a new script, shows a preview, and only generates the avatar after you say "go ahead".
textos.motores.refazvideo.serve: Explain a topic from a good video in Portuguese, without filming yourself.
textos.motores.rtex.acionamento: Terminal or bot: /rtex <tema> in inemaccbot; queued with a timer
textos.motores.rtex.avatar: Yes — Nei's avatar from the HeyGen studio
textos.motores.rtex.oque: An "N pieces" reel: one topic per video, a strong hook in the opening frame, the method's steps, and, at the end, an opinion question for the audience to answer. A validator, automated critic, and QA check the format before publishing.
textos.motores.rtex.serve: A method or list reel ("the 3 pieces of…") designed to prompt comments.
textos.motores.rtexjp.avatar: Illustrated character of Nei (no HeyGen), local voice
textos.motores.rtexjp.oque: Creates illustrated reels in navy blue from a roteiro.json script: generates the voice on the computer, draws each scene, mixes the soundtrack, and checks the format automatically. No recording and no paid avatar service.
textos.motores.rtexjp.serve: An rtex-style reel when there is no recorded avatar: everything is illustrated.
textos.motores.saudeviral.acionamento: Timer: Monday to Friday at 05:00, weekly recap on Saturday
textos.motores.saudeviral.oque: The same radar for doctors, nutritionists, and psychologists with the largest audiences: everything is reported and attributed, and topics without medical consensus are labeled “NO CONSENSUS.” Does not replace a medical consultation.
textos.motores.saudeviral.serve: Daily summary of what health influencers said.
textos.motores.traducao.acionamento: Terminal (session) + fila-espanhol with a timer (1 video every 2 h, up to 8 per day)
textos.motores.traducao.avatar: Yes — Nei’s avatar and voice in the target language
textos.motores.traducao.oque: Adapts a finished video into English and Spanish in the same format as the Portuguese version: the script and cues are translated by the central translator, Nei’s avatar and voice speak the new language, and explicavideos handles the edit. In Spanish, each video joins a queue that publishes gradually on the Inema Espanhol channel.
textos.motores.traducao.serve: EN/ES versions of explainers, reels, and lessons.
textos.motores.video-codigo.acionamento: Terminal (skill in Claude Code or Codex)
textos.motores.video-codigo.avatar: No (a face is optional, up to half the screen)
textos.motores.video-codigo.oque: A skill for Claude Code and Codex where every frame is written in code (HTML, Canvas, or SVG) and turned into an MP4. When there is a voiceover, it is generated on the computer, and each image appears at the exact moment the word is spoken.
textos.motores.video-codigo.serve: A launch, announcement, explainer, or product film without a camera or editor.
textos.motores.video-sem-rosto.nota_exemplos: No videos from this engine have been published on YouTube yet; demo videos are in the project guide.
textos.motores.video-sem-rosto.oque: A kit that teaches Claude Code to make landscape explainers without filming: cloned voice generated on your computer, the real website page, 3D images, and synced captions.
textos.motores.video-sem-rosto.serve: Explain a tool, a repository, or a new release without appearing on camera.
textos.motores.videos-cursos-inema.avatar: No — narration with a locally cloned voice
textos.motores.videos-cursos-inema.nota_exemplo: No videos from this engine appear in the publication history; the project guide shows the FEP course example.
textos.motores.videos-cursos-inema.oque: An engine that turns an INEMA course (static website) into a narrated, animated video series in three selectable parts: landing page, one video per learning path, and a complete lesson for each module.
textos.motores.videos-cursos-inema.serve: Promotional videos and lessons for a course.
textos.motores.vigia-canal.oque: Checks a reference channel every day. If there is a new video, it creates an explainer video inspired by the content, in Nei’s voice, and publishes it directly. If there is no new video, it does nothing and never repeats a video.
textos.motores.vigia-canal.serve: Automatic explainers whenever new content appears in the reference, without anyone asking.

textos.readme.processo.0.1: New engine or text change: edit `catalogo.json` (text in PT, video identification rule, `excluir`/`fixar`).
textos.readme.processo.1.1: `python3 traduzir.py` — translates only new keys into EN/ES using the central `inema-traduz` translator, then writes `i18n/en.json` and `i18n/es.json`.
textos.readme.processo.2.1: `python3 atualizar-exemplos.py` — reads the yt-pubx history (`~/.local/share/yt-pubx/historico.jsonl`) and, if available, the production log (separating explicavideo from refazvideo); selects up to 3 recent, varied public videos per engine and writes `motores.json`.
textos.readme.processo.3.1: The same command runs `python3 gerar.py`, which regenerates `README.md`, `README.en.md`, `README.es.md`, `guia/index.html`, `guia/en/`, and `guia/es/` from `motores.json`.
textos.readme.processo.4.1: Check the page and README; `git push`. GitHub Pages (Actions) publishes from the `main` branch.
textos.readme.processo_legenda: 🧠 = session with Nei · ⚙️ = script (no tokens used) · 🤖 = `claude -p`
textos.readme.processo_nota: Outside the machine that publishes the videos, there is no yt-pubx history: the script gives a warning, keeps the examples already in `motores.json`, and applies only the new text. The examples are not checked again on YouTube: the script only reads local files. A rejected or replaced video goes in `excluir` in `catalogo.json`.

textos.ui.passos.0.1: You need Python 3 and git. ffprobe (from FFmpeg) is optional. It helps identify whether each video is 16:9 or 9:16.
textos.ui.passos.1.0: New video engine? Describe it in catalogo.json
textos.ui.passos.1.1: Add the engine with the text in Portuguese and a rule that identifies its videos (source folder or channel). Use "excluir" to remove a video and "fixar" to choose one.
textos.ui.passos.2.1: The English and Spanish texts are in i18n/en.json and i18n/es.json. The script uses INEMA's central translator (the inema-traduz command, which is only available on INEMA's machine) for missing keys. Without it, write the translations by hand in those two files.

textos.ui.resumo: This repository is an index. It explains, on one page, each engine INEMA uses to make videos: explainers, reels, daily radar updates, and videos made with code. Use it to find the right engine or learn about one. Each engine entry explains what it does, what kind of video it is for, its format, whether it uses an avatar, how it is triggered, links to its code, and up to 3 real videos published on YouTube. You don’t need to install anything to read it.
